reviews.title: Disappointed
reviews.text: I returned three dresses from my order, but I was only refunded for one of them. After contacting customer service, I was told there was no proof that I had returned all three items, despite the fact that they were sent back together. I have been trying to resolve this issue for over six weeks and still have not received the remaining refund. This experience has been very frustrating and disappointing. I expected a fair investigation and better customer support. Unfortunately, I cannot recommend this company based on my experience.

reviews.title: Don’t take accountability of what they put on the website
reviews.text:
The customer service and quality assurance on this app are getting worse by the day. Many brands listed here seem to lack accountability, and unfortunately, the company itself doesn’t take responsibility for the products sold through its platform.
My recent experience was especially disappointing , a customer service agent indirectly accused me of lying instead of addressing the issue professionally. Other retail websites take accountability for the quality of the items they feature, and I hope voga starts doing the same.
